title: OrphanRecoveryDecision
description: One row appended to <workspace>/logs/orphan-recoveries.jsonl by the boot-time StaleProgressArchiver. Records what happened to each candidate folder in 3-progress: surfaced loudly in 3a-failed-pickup as orphan or empty (ADR-0028), recovered into 4-auto-review via a missed transition, or skipped. Pairs with the crash-recovery doctrine (ADR-0020): crash-recovery rescues file changes, this sweep rescues the lane shape so the one-task-per-project promise holds visually.

at.description: UTC timestamp at which the sweep made the decision.

kind.description: Outcome class. The 'fresh' and 'skipped' transient verdicts are not persisted; only actionable outcomes land in the JSONL. ADR-0028 replaced the pre-loud-not-archive 'archived-orphan' / 'archived-empty' / 'archive-failed' kinds with 'moved-to-failed-pickup' / 'move-to-failed-pickup-failed'.

projectName.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

slug.description: Original folder slug under 3-progress at the time of the sweep.

jobId.description: Job id read from job.json when present; usually equal to the folder slug.

failedPickupSlug.description: Slug under 3a-failed-pickup after the move (ADR-0028). Format: '<original>-orphan-<yyyy-mm-dd>' or '<original>-empty-<yyyy-mm-dd>', with a numeric suffix on collisions. Absent for recovered-to-review.

failureKind.description: Which boot-sweep verdict produced the move. Set on moved-to-failed-pickup.

targetState.description: Destination state folder. Only set on successful moves.

sentinelKeyword.description: Completion sentinel found in the last 50 lines of cli-output.log. Set on recovered-to-review and recovery-failed.

ageSeconds.description: Folder age at the time of the sweep, in seconds. Recorded for diagnostic verdicts only.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the verdict; surfaces in the structured backend log line.
